compiled_state.title: As an engineer, integration tests exercise the full loop end-to-end against Anthropic and OpenAI
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Integration tests dispatching the full augmentation loop against both Anthropic and OpenAI on fixture diffs. Validates that the dispatcher, parser, handlers, soft-cap cascade, and caching all compose correctly under real provider responses (not just mocked).

**Why**: SC6 (integration portion). Unit tests with respx/httpx.MockTransport cover individual components per S1-S5; integration tests close the gap on inter-component composition under live providers.

**Scope**:
- IN: full-loop integration tests against Anthropic and OpenAI on a small fixture set; assertion that grounded findings emerge from real provider runs
- OUT: cross-provider fallback tests (covered in c6de SC6); load testing; performance benchmarking

## Done Definitions

- When complete, integration tests dispatch a full loop against both providers and assert findings are produced and structurally valid ← Satisfies: SC6 (integration tests)

## Considerations

- [Testing] Integration tests require live API keys in CI secrets; cost is bounded by the small fixture set; cache-hit means most calls are cheap after first turn

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
